title: Pair-code validity with bounded space
statement: There exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every Boolean string $x$, $M$ halts within $c(|x|+1)$ steps and outputs the one-bit string whose bit is true exactly when the pair parser succeeds on $x$. For every $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work space used by $M$ through step $t$ is at most $c$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Turing machine and constant exist
correct one-bit output for every input
space bound c for every input and every t
